title: Classify a concurrent credit-admission winner during artifact reads as retryable
outcome: When another initial credit admission updates the exact registration during off-lock artifact I/O, return a retryable admission-unavailable result that reconciles the winner's nonce, while preserving true immutable request mismatch refusals.
acceptance: An exact-row change caused by a concurrent admission between the first and second lock returns admission_unavailable rather than request_mismatch, without replacing the winner's admission identity.
A deterministic phase-controlled regression distinguishes that race from an actual immutable request mismatch, and existing admission durability/idempotence controls pass.
